_comment: Real values for tools/sync-console-live-drive.mjs (ticket 450). A TODO value SKIPs its checks, and a SKIP is not green. The write sections run only with --write, and only on the TEST stores named here: never a store that trades. The read codes P001/P002 were picked 2026-10-10 from the LOCAL POS_Server; the write and re-push stores stay TODO in the repo on purpose, so a run pointed at staging never writes to a store nobody chose for it (locally P134 was used).
testStoreOnWpf: TODO: a TEST store on WPF that may be moved to the worker and handed back (--write)
testStoreForTest: TODO: a TEST store whose connection may be tested (--write)
rePushStoreCode: TODO: a worker store to PREVIEW a re-push on. Preview only: the drive never confirms a re-push
